title: Property Descriptions
description: Natural-language guidance attached to individual parameters and nested properties.
question: Do property-level descriptions survive at each capture boundary?
notes: Exposed by both adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Exposed by both adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 and Pydantic AI 2.40.0 expose it at the declared capture boundary. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tools documenting individual parameters.
known_issues: Three framework adapters could not be measured against 2026-07-28, so missing evidence is not a support result.
why: Property descriptions carry the author's parameter-level intent. Losing them can make a structurally valid tool call semantically wrong.
reproduce: uv run mcp-mirror scan "python fixtures/tricky_server.py" --runner managed --frameworks openai_agents,pydantic_ai --spec-version 2026-07-28 --job J2
